name: core-runtime-messaging-email-base-accessors-evidence
salesforceExclusionReason: The test depends on Glade-local Messaging.Email public fields and object identity, hash, and string behavior; it grants zero Salesforce parity credit.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingEmailBaseAccessorsEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.Email email = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); email.setBccSender(true); email.setEmailPriority('High'); email.setReplyTo('reply@example.test'); email.setSaveAsActivity(false); email.setSenderDisplayName('Trail Sender'); email.setSubject('Trail Subject'); email.setUseSignature(false); System.assertEquals(true, email.getBccSender()); System.assertEquals('High', email.getEmailPriority()); System.assertEquals('reply@example.test', email.getReplyTo()); System.assertEquals(false, email.getSaveAsActivity()); System.assertEquals('Trail Sender', email.getSenderDisplayName()); System.assertEquals('Trail Subject', email.getSubject()); System.assertEquals(false, email.getUseSignature()); email.bccSender = true; email.emailPriority = 'High'; email.replyTo = 'reply@example.test'; email.saveAsActivity = false; email.senderDisplayName = 'Trail Sender'; email.subject = 'Trail Subject'; email.useSignature = false; System.assertEquals(true, email.bccSender); System.assertEquals('High', email.emailPriority); System.assertEquals('reply@example.test', email.replyTo); System.assertEquals(false, email.saveAsActivity); System.assertEquals('Trail Sender', email.senderDisplayName); System.assertEquals('Trail Subject', email.subject); System.assertEquals(false, email.useSignature); Messaging.Email otherEmail = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); System.assertEquals(true, email.equals(email)); System.assertEquals(false, email.equals(otherEmail)); System.assertEquals(false, email.equals(null)); System.assertNotEquals(null, email.hashCode()); System.assertEquals(email.hashCode(), email.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, email.toString()); } }
